fieldDefinitions.tradeDate: Official TWSE MI_QFIIS report / trading date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format
fieldDefinitions.securityName: Official security short name from the MI_QFIIS 證券名稱 column
fieldDefinitions.issuedShares: Official total issued shares (發行股數) for 0056 as published (source unit: 股 / shares)
fieldDefinitions.foreignHeldShares: Official total foreign and mainland investor held shares (全體外資及陸資持有股數) for 0056 as published (source unit: 股 / shares)
fieldDefinitions.foreignHoldingRatio: Official total foreign and mainland investor shareholding ratio (全體外資及陸資持股比率) for 0056 as published (source unit: 百分比 / percentage points 0.0 - 100.0%)
fieldDefinitions.foreignRemainingInvestableShares: Official foreign and mainland investor remaining investable shares (外資及陸資尚可投資股數) for 0056 as published (source unit: 股 / shares)
fieldDefinitions.foreignRemainingInvestableRatio: Official foreign and mainland investor remaining investable ratio (外資及陸資尚可投資比率) for 0056 as published (source unit: 百分比 / percentage points 0.0 - 100.0%)
fieldDefinitions.statutoryInvestmentLimitRatio: Official foreign and mainland investor statutory investment limit ratio (外資及陸資共用法令投資上限比率) for 0056 as published (source unit: 百分比 / percentage points 0.0 - 100.0%)
fieldDefinitions.sourceRetrievedAt: ISO UTC timestamp when this qualification run retrieved the official record (provenance only; not historicalAvailableAt, publicationTimestamp, or featureEligibilityTimestamp)

ratioUnitSemantics: Official ratio fields (foreignHoldingRatio, foreignRemainingInvestableRatio, statutoryInvestmentLimitRatio) represent percentage points (0.0 to 100.0%) as published in TWSE tables.
revisionSemantics: V1 uses official current-day foreign & mainland investor shareholding statistics. Same-day eligibility is forbidden. sourceRetrievedAt is retrieval provenance only and is not a historical publication timestamp. Exact historical publication minutes are not used.
